title: Sample Pay raises $2.5 million seed round to expand in Kenya
text:
Nairobi-based Sample Pay has raised $2.5 million in a seed round led by Example Ventures, with participation from Placeholder Capital.
The company will use the money to grow its merchant network.

title: Kenyan agritech Sample Farm secures KES 40m grant
text: Sample Farm, which sells inputs to smallholder farmers, has secured a KES 40m grant from the Placeholder Foundation.

title: Sample Health closes Series A at $12m
text: Health-tech startup Sample Health has closed a $12m Series A round co-led by Example Ventures and Demo Partners.

title: Five things we learned at the Nairobi founders meetup
text: More than 200 founders met in Westlands this week. Speakers said the market for seed funding has slowed.
